bullets.text: MTD for Income Tax Exemptions - **HMRC** allows limited exemptions for individuals under **Making Tax Digital** rules starting April 2026.
Bookkeepers as Human APIs - **Bookkeepers** are essential connectors in the fragmented systems of **UK** small businesses.
Soft Landing for MTD Penalties - A new 'soft landing' period offers penalty relief for the first year of **MTD for Income Tax**.
Prepare for MTD Client Sign-ups - Sign up clients for **MTD** before the April 2026 deadline to avoid chaos.
